Massively underestimated:

The “cost” of people coming to work knowing things are broken & fearing the next thing breaking.

This holds for usability issues, “bugs”, “quality”, elephants in the room, strategy misalignment...anything.

The drag and dissonance is extremely costly.
design and developers weigh in on the "best" product manager they've worked with...

Quick fix for 2020

Relabel your “done” column and/or add a column for measuring/monitoring.

For each item, do a quick review. What have you learned?

Done is rarely done.
